a letter for you

Dear favourite human,

Happy Boyfriend's Day to the person who has a very special place in my heart.

I made this little website because a normal message didn't feel big enough for all the memories we have. From the silly pictures to the quiet moments, I love having a little collection of us.

I hope we keep collecting days like these — laughing at nonsense, taking too many pictures, annoying each other a little, and choosing each other again and again.

Always your girl ♡

P.S. You are stuck with me now. Sorry, no refunds. 🐻💗🐼
